note.en: Heated pool, sauna, hammam, Nordic baths with Mont Blanc views
note.ro: Piscina incalzita, sauna, hammam, bai nordice cu vedere spre Mont Blanc

notes.en: Any flight landing before Anca's. Update time when booked. Glen waits at arrivals.
notes.ro: Orice zbor care aterizeaza inaintea Ancai. Actualizeaza ora. Glen asteapta la sosiri.

notes.en: Airbus A320neo, 1h50. Cabin bags only saves time at the carousel. ID card is fine — Italy is Schengen.
notes.ro: Airbus A320neo, 1h50. Doar bagaj de cabina. Carte de identitate — Italia e Schengen.

planB.en: Flight delayed? Coaches into Milan run until around midnight.
planB.ro: Zborul intarzie? Autocarele spre Milano circula pana pe la miezul noptii.

notes.en: Flibco, Terravision or Autostradale. Bus bays outside arrivals. Every 20-30 min, about 8-12 EUR each.
notes.ro: Flibco, Terravision sau Autostradale. Statii de autocar la iesirea din sosiri. La fiecare 20-30 min, ~8-12 EUR/pers.

notes.en: A short walk from the station. Look for 24-hour reception.
notes.ro: La cativa pasi de gara. Cauta receptie non-stop.

notes.en: Up early. Coffee at the station or the hotel.
notes.ro: Trezire devreme. Cafea la gara sau la hotel.

notes.en: Seat reservation compulsory and included. Past Lake Maggiore and Domodossola, then through the Simplon tunnel into Switzerland. Be at the platform by 06:55 — boards show it 15 min before.
notes.ro: Rezervare loc obligatorie si inclusa. Pe langa Lacul Maggiore si Domodossola, apoi prin tunelul Simplon in Elvetia. Fii la peron pana la 06:55 — afisajul arata peronul cu 15 min inainte.

planB.en: Missed it? EC 40 at 08:10, arrives Brig 10:14. Same connections about an hour later; in Les Houches mid-afternoon.
planB.ro: L-ai pierdut? EC 40 la 08:10, sosire Brig 10:14. Aceleasi conexiuni cu ~1h mai tarziu; in Les Houches dupa-amiaza.

notes.en: Every 30 min, about 47-50 min. Take the first after arrival. Direction: Lausanne or Geneva Airport.
notes.ro: La fiecare 30 min, ~47-50 min. Ia primul dupa sosire. Directia: Lausanne sau Geneva Airport.

planB.en: Trains every 30 min. If you miss one, take the next.
planB.ro: Trenuri la fiecare 30 min. Daca pierzi unul, ia-l pe urmatorul.

notes.en: Hourly. About 50 min, up through the Trient gorge. The connection at Martigny can mean a wait of up to an hour. Own bay platform in the same station.
notes.ro: Orar. ~50 min, prin cheile Trient. Conexiunea la Martigny poate insemna o asteptare de pana la o ora. Peron separat in aceeasi gara.

planB.en: Line disrupted? Sometimes runs replacement buses. Follow signs at Martigny.
planB.ro: Linia intrerupta? Uneori ruleaza autobuze de inlocuire. Urmeaza indicatoarele la Martigny.

notes.en: French train towards Saint-Gervais. Usually waiting across the platform at Vallorcine. Through Argentiere and Chamonix — stay on at Chamonix.
notes.ro: Trenul francez spre Saint-Gervais. De obicei asteapta pe peronul opus la Vallorcine. Prin Argentiere si Chamonix — ramai in tren la Chamonix.

planB.en: Replacement bus from Vallorcine — follow the signs.
planB.ro: Autobuz de inlocuire de la Vallorcine — urmeaza indicatoarele.

notes.en: Check in, collect the Carte d'Hote, shop at Carrefour. The afternoon is yours.
notes.ro: Check-in, colecteaza Carte d'Hote, cumparaturi la Carrefour. Dupa-amiaza e a voastra.

notes.en: Les Houches ski area opens Dec 19 — today try the Tramway du Mont Blanc to Bellevue (1800 m), snowshoe in the valley, or warm up at the Deep Nature Spa (heated pool, sauna, Nordic baths). Brévent/Flégère and Grands Montets ski areas are open if you want to ski. Carrefour for supplies.
notes.ro: Domeniul schiabil Les Houches se deschide pe 19 dec — azi incearca Tramvaiul Mont Blanc spre Bellevue (1800 m), plimbare cu rachete in vale, sau incalzire la Deep Nature Spa (piscina, sauna, bai nordice). Brévent/Flégère si Grands Montets sunt deschise daca vrei sa schiezi. Carrefour pentru provizii.

notes.en: Aiguille du Midi opens today (Dec 19)! Cable car 8:10–16:30, last round trip at 15:00 — go early. 3,842 m summit with Mont Blanc panorama. Then walk to the Montenvers rack railway for Mer de Glace (last departure 14:30). Chamonix Christmas market likely open from today too — mulled wine, raclette, crêpes on Place du Triangle de l'Amitié.
notes.ro: Aiguille du Midi se deschide azi (19 dec)! Telecabina 8:10–16:30, ultima tura dus-intors la 15:00 — mergi devreme. Varf la 3.842 m cu panorama Mont Blanc. Apoi mergi la Montenvers cu trenul cu cremaliera spre Mer de Glace (ultima plecare 14:30). Targul de Craciun din Chamonix probabil deschis de azi — vin fiert, raclette, clatite pe Place du Triangle de l'Amitié.

notes.en: Les Houches ski area is now open. Ski or take the Bellevue gondola for views. Deep Nature Spa for a rest day. Christmas market in Chamonix still running if you missed it. Pack in the evening.
notes.ro: Domeniul Les Houches e acum deschis. Schiaza sau ia telecabina Bellevue pentru privelistea. Deep Nature Spa pentru o zi de odihna. Targul de Craciun din Chamonix inca deschis daca l-ai ratat. Fa bagajele seara.

notes.ro: De actualizat cu detaliile calatoriei de intoarcere.

planB.en: If the coach is full, train back via Martigny, Brig, Milan.
planB.ro: Daca autocarul e plin, tren prin Martigny, Brig, Milano.

note.en: Long-term December averages, not a forecast. Real forecasts start to mean something about ten days out.
note.ro: Medii pe termen lung pentru decembrie, nu o prognoza. Prognozele reale devin utile cu aproximativ zece zile inainte.

notes.en: Rain on roughly a quarter of December days. Bergamo airport runs much the same.
notes.ro: Ploua in aproximativ un sfert din zilele de decembrie. Aeroportul Bergamo este similar.

notes.en: December is the snowiest month: about 56 cm of snowfall on average. Nights well below freezing; pavements icy in the mornings.
notes.ro: Decembrie este luna cu cea mai multa zapada: in medie aproximativ 56 cm. Noptile sunt sub zero; trotuarele sunt alunecoase dimineata.

notes.en: The gondola down to the glacier opens for winter on 19 Dec 2026, so go on the 19th or later.
notes.ro: Telecabina spre ghetar se deschide pentru iarna pe 19 dec 2026, deci mergeti pe 19 sau mai tarziu.

notes.en: Wind chill takes it much lower. Even in summer the viewing terraces can drop to -10°C. Hat, gloves, every layer you have.
notes.ro: Vantul o face mult mai rece. Chiar si vara terasele pot cobori la -10°C. Caciula, manusi, toate straturile.

estimateNote.en: Estimate: valley average minus about 0.6°C per 100 m of height. No published averages for this station.
estimateNote.ro: Estimare: media din vale minus aproximativ 0,6°C la fiecare 100 m altitudine. Nu exista medii publicate pentru aceasta statie.
